descripcion.en: Greetings, your name, spelling, and numbers up to 100.
Ser, articles, describing people, estar, the present, family and possessives.
Directions, hay and está, this and that, the house, the café, likes and the time.
Routine, what is happening now, obligations, shopping, clothes, weather, health, plans to meet and commands.
Plans, the indefinido, the perfect, the imperfect, and the difference between them.
Object pronouns, comparison, the superlative, por and para.
Skills, emotions, an earlier past, wishes, the future, belief and an imagined if.
Relative clauses, accidental se, reported speech and wishes about the past.
Purpose with para que, and the connectors that join a longer turn.
